summary: A fresh real-BB pass confirmed the revised no-pill Host Monitor 0.1.2 UI: Critical, Attention, and Healthy render as borderless inline text with visible semantic orbs; All, Attention, and Offline are underline filters controlling the fleet result region; only attention and critical rows have thin semantic rails; and the compact summary is a labelled definition list with health shown before connectivity. BB's permanent Host Monitor icon stayed neutral with no notification pseudo-element. Executable cases cover offline, disconnected, unavailable, sampling, and malformed states absent from the live fleet.
